name: Blueprint

test_list.description: Create a digest-pinned blueprint, serialize and parse it, then reject content tampering.
Reject mutable image tags and malformed policy references.
Produce ordered onboarding actions and preserve unprobed facts as UNKNOWN.
Build the guest and install it under /usr/bin where the verified default sandbox policy permits execution.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Versioned image and policy blueprint with a canonical BLAKE3 digest.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: OpenShell backend that can attach named provider profile references.

inputs.name: probes
inputs.description: Observed host facts from the platform probe layer.

output_description: An applied sandbox only after digest verification and guest protocol handshake.
